known_traps: treating the three phases as a simple repeated-read case
asserting a bottleneck from missing profile detail
acceptable_alternatives: a measurement-first plan that distinguishes reduction decomposition options

known_traps: choosing boundary combination from the intermediate alone
ignoring measured spills and low launch cost
acceptable_alternatives: remap or split the phases with a measured register/occupancy experiment
failure_criteria: claiming a launch benefit larger than supplied evidence

known_traps: blindly applying a repeated-use residency idea
failure_criteria: recommendation to keep the full row live without addressing spill

known_traps: using a single local fraction as universal evidence
acceptable_alternatives: rank the structural path first while measuring workload-mix sensitivity
failure_criteria: 8x micro result treated as 8x system result

acceptable_alternatives: measure transactions, cache behavior, occupancy, kernel decomposition, and isolated boundary timing
failure_criteria: asserting memory-bound or compute-bound as measured fact
